dragonBones.CCFactory.constructor.coverageReason: CCFactory is a process-wide singleton. Its constructor subscribes to game restart and registers the global DragonBones update schedule; direct extra construction can duplicate global ownership. Use the verified getInstance() entry point.

dragonBones.CCFactory.onRestart.coverageReason: Engine restart callback only. Direct invocation clears the singleton while live armatures may still reference the current factory; restart ownership remains with the engine event.

dragonBones.ArmatureDisplay.destroyRende.coverageReason: Tagged engine-internal render lifecycle hook. Clearing draw data outside component/render ownership can invalidate submitted UI geometry; the live draw list and component render path are verified.

dragonBones.ArmatureDisplay.onDestroy.coverageReason: Component lifecycle callback paired with base cleanup. Node.destroy owns this path; direct invocation on a live node bypasses component teardown ordering.
